Rook includes FFmpeg for generated-video thumbnail and frame sidecar extraction.
FFmpeg is third-party software. Rook invokes ffmpeg.exe as a subprocess and does
not link FFmpeg libraries.

Bundled FFmpeg version: 8.1.1
Bundled build: Rook-owned minimal LGPL-only Windows ffmpeg.exe
Official source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.1.tar.xz
Release source bundle: generated by scripts\ffmpeg\build-rook-ffmpeg.ps1 and
published beside the Rook installer.

License policy for Rook release packaging: LGPL-only; release validation rejects
GPL-enabled, nonfree, broad third-party, or unexpected externally-enabled builds.
